scope: Native text clipboard and simple/block selection. No app/Android, daemon, worker or wire changes. Installed clients and port 6767 untouched.
changes: Borrowed-grid selection background/foreground use generated authored terminal theme tokens.
Forward/reverse pointer drag, Shift extension and Alt block model; selected text retained in warm terminal views.
Ctrl+C copies selection on Linux/Windows; without selection it remains an interrupt. Ctrl+Shift+C consumes the clipboard shortcut. Mac uses Command+C.
Ctrl+V/Ctrl+Shift+V on Linux/Windows and Command+V on Mac use xterm-matched text paste encoding; empty clipboard leaves selection unchanged.
Typing clears selection and returns to live bottom only when needed.
Copied NBSP becomes space; the Windows clipboard boundary uses CRLF.

platforms: macOS runtime-shaders native check plus focused core tests
Windows MSVC native check plus focused core tests

sourceCoverage: Primary GUI checks preceded only the final clipboard text-boundary normalization helper. Final-source smoke verifies NBSP copy normalization, pasting the app-owned OS clipboard, selection clearing and Ctrl+C; both boolean OS branches also have focused tests on all three platforms. Native selection rendering and paste encoding are unchanged between those snapshots.

copyOracle.producer: Installed browser xterm in an actual Electron renderer; service selectionText over real terminal buffers

knownMismatch.name: hard-newline
knownMismatch.reason: Alacritty trims the row to its nonblank line length; explicit trailing spaces and untouched blanks have the same stored character.
knownMismatch.acceptance: NOT_PASSED; complete terminal copy fidelity remains required.

projectionAllocationRegression.result: 0 allocation/reallocation calls per measured traversal in sparse, dense and Unicode/style workloads; see raw log.
projectionAllocationRegression.scope: Same grid-projection stage and benchmark as prior checkpoint; no whole-render or RSS/CPU/latency claim.

limitations: Full original Electron UI and terminal fidelity are NOT_PASSED.
Hard-line trailing-space copy mismatch remains unresolved. Tab/word/line and full selection fidelity still require audit.
Double/triple click, drag autoscroll, right-click menus, middle-button paste, images, full IME/keyboard/mouse protocols and reconnect remain incomplete.
Mouse capture only gates local selection here; pointer protocol forwarding is not implemented.
Alt block selection is covered by the real models, not an OS modifier/drag test. Mac and Windows GUI clipboard interaction remains unverified.
deployment: No deployment or daemon restart. Both isolated fixture homes, their PTYs and QA display/WM were cleaned; the oracle browser and native windows were closed.
